title: SAP NetWeaver (Internet Graphics Service) does not sufficiently validate certain input values within… (CVE-2026-120008)
description: SAP NetWeaver Internet Graphics Service contains a vulnerability due to insufficient validation of certain input values in incoming requests. An unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted request that triggers an out-of-bounds memory write in a worker process. This can cause memory corruption or repeated termination of the affected process, leading to significant availability disruption. The vulnerability impacts availability highly, has a low impact on integrity, and no impact on confidentiality.
